claims.rationale: Primary sources refute the minted mechanism: MIGOS's long-cycle-tie value is 0 (thesis §5.3.2; ICGA 2009 §3.3 'typically 0'), identical to our TIE=0; MIGOS's own basic-ko 4×4 = +1 = ours (thesis Table 5.1); the +2 anchor arises from the pass-difference cycle-resolution rule (thesis Appendix A §A.4), a different game definition. Run half pending under HOLD D011.

Under aligned rules (basic ko, tie 0) weizigo fixpoint (+1) and MIGOS search (+1, thesis Table 5.1) agree; the +1-vs-+2 gap is a ruleset (cycle-resolution) difference, not a fixpoint-vs-search discrepancy. Candidate (b) (defect) not needed to explain the gap; our value for our game still awaits the #2 auditor.
